description: Phase 3 (Library + TV Channels) design-match fixes in the View-based LibraryActivity.kt and AutoBridgeDesign.kt (fixes 9-19 from the audit). Depends on FEAT-001 only in sequence — touches different files and will not conflict. Uses AutoBridgeDesign color tokens. No Compose changes.
steps: Fix 9 — Remove the 'Favorites' chip. In LibraryActivity.kt the `chips` list (~line 97) is: [TV, RADIO, MUSIC, STREAMING, FILES, FAVORITES]. Remove Section.FAVORITES from this list so only 5 chips remain (TV, Radio, Music, Streaming, Files). Keep the FAVORITES Section enum value itself — it is used elsewhere (e.g. via intent extra) — just remove it from the chip bar. The Favorites content remains accessible via the Home quick-launch tile.

Fix 10 — Section-letter headers accent color. In showLibraryCategories(), the grouped category letter headers are rendered via AutoBridgeDesign.sectionLabel(this, letter). That function in AutoBridgeDesign.kt (~line 239-246) always sets setTextColor(TEXT_MUTED). Since other callers (like 'All categories' and 'PINNED') use the same sectionLabel and should stay muted, do NOT change the sectionLabel function. Instead, in showLibraryCategories() where letter headers are created, call .also { it.setTextColor(AutoBridgeDesign.ACCENT) } on the letter header view to override to accent color. Only the letter headers (val header = AutoBridgeDesign.sectionLabel(this, letter) near the grouped.forEach block) get this override — 'All categories', 'PINNED', 'Channels', 'Categories' headers stay muted.

Fix 11 — 'A-Z' sort dropdown. Add a sort affordance to the 'ALL CATEGORIES · N' header in showLibraryCategories(). Currently it's just: rows += AutoBridgeDesign.sectionLabel(this, "All categories • ${data.categories.size}"). Replace that with a LinearLayout (horizontal) containing the existing sectionLabel on the left (weight=1) and a small clickable TextView on the right showing 'A–Z ▼' or 'Z–A ▲'. Add a var sortAscending = true before the draw lambda. On click, toggle sortAscending and call draw(). In the grouped map building, use .toSortedMap(if (sortAscending) compareBy { categoryLetterSortKey(it) } else compareByDescending { categoryLetterSortKey(it) }). Add new string resources: library_sort_az ("A–Z ▼") and library_sort_za ("Z–A ▲") in EN, and Thai equivalents in values-th.

Fix 12 — 'Edit' link for PINNED section. Currently showLibraryCategories() renders rows += AutoBridgeDesign.sectionLabel(this, "Pinned"). Replace with a LinearLayout (horizontal) containing the sectionLabel on the left (weight=1) and a clickable accent-colored TextView 'Edit' on the right. On click, open pin management: show an AlertDialog listing all categories with checkboxes for their pinned state (read from IptvPinnedCategoryStore.pinned(this, source.id), toggle with IptvPinnedCategoryStore.toggle(this, source.id, categoryId), call refresh() on dismiss). Add new string resources: library_edit_pinned ("Edit") in EN, and Thai equivalent in values-th.

Fix 13 — Source card trailing chevron + leading folder icon. In the sourceCard() method: (a) change trailing = "⋯" to trailing = "▾" (a dropdown chevron glyph). The onTrailing handler (sourceMenu) stays the same. (b) Change badgeText from the letter ("X"/"M") to a folder glyph: badgeText = "📁". AutoBridgeDesign.contentRow renders badgeText in a small accent circle; a single glyph works there.

Fix 14 — Grid 3 columns. LibraryActivity.showEntries() calls AutoBridgeDesign.grid(this, shown.map { entryTile(source, it, shown) }). This defaults to columns=2. Pass columns = 3: AutoBridgeDesign.grid(this, shown.map { entryTile(source, it, shown) }, columns = 3).

Fix 15 — Header subtitle. In showEntries() the subtitle is built as: val counted = if (query.isBlank()) plural(all.size, "entry", "entries") else "...". Change the non-search case from plural(all.size, "entry", "entries") to "${all.size} channels · ${source.name}". The searching case stays as-is. The 'showing first N' fallback subtitle (~10 lines later) should also use 'channels' instead of the old counted string, but the tail logic remains the same.

Fix 16 — Filled star in header. In showEntries() the headerActions list currently has 2 items: grid/list toggle and the signal icon. Add a third header action (FIRST in the list, so it appears leftmost): a star that toggles IptvPinnedCategoryStore for the current category. val isPinned = IptvPinnedCategoryStore.isPinned(this@LibraryActivity, source.id, categoryId); add AutoBridgeDesign.HeaderAction(glyph = if (isPinned) "★" else "☆", filled = isPinned, tint = if (isPinned) AutoBridgeDesign.ACCENT_FAVORITE else null, onClick = { IptvPinnedCategoryStore.toggle(this@LibraryActivity, source.id, categoryId); draw() }).

Fix 17 — Move 'Check' to status line. (a) Remove the second HeaderAction (the 📶 signal icon) from the headerActions list in showEntries(). Keep the grid/list toggle and the new star. (b) In the checkSummaryRow() method, add a new clickable pill/button at the right side, between the status text and the 'Hide offline' pill. Use AutoBridgeDesign.pill(this, "↻ Check", primary = false, accent = accent, onClick = { recheckEntries(shown) }). The 'Hide offline' pill stays in its current position. The HeaderAction tag (SIGNAL_ACTION_TAG) and signalIndicator references for the removed header action should be cleaned up (remove signalIndicator usages for the entries page if they cause compile errors; the signalTint() calls still update pingTiles colors). Add new string resource: library_check_button ("↻ Check") EN, Thai equivalent in values-th.

Fix 18 — Status dots colored green/red. In checkSummaryRow(), the text "● $online online   ● $offline offline" is all in TEXT_MUTED. Replace the single TextView with a horizontal layout: green dot (●) + " $online online   " + red dot (●) + " $offline offline". Use a SpannableStringBuilder with ForegroundColorSpan: the first ● gets ACCENT_ONLINE (0xFF5BE3B4), and the second ● gets DANGER (0xFFFF9AA8). The rest of the text stays TEXT_MUTED. Or use two separate TextViews: first with green dot prefix, second with red dot prefix.

Fix 19 — Status indicator on tiles: small colored dot instead of text. In AutoBridgeDesign.contentTile() (~line 396 in AutoBridgeDesign.kt), the status parameter currently renders as a labeled TextView (R.id.autobridge_status_label). Change this: instead of showing the text label, show a small 8dp colored dot (View with GradientDrawable oval) positioned at the bottom-end corner of the artwork FrameLayout. The dot color comes from status.second (the Int color). Hide the dot when status is null. Keep the R.id.autobridge_status_label view for the setStatus() function compatibility but make it GONE. Add the dot as a child of the artwork FrameLayout, positioned with Gravity.BOTTOM or Gravity.END, with a 4dp margin, on top of the image. The setStatus() function should also update this dot.
Add all new EN strings to app/src/main/res/values/strings.xml and TH strings to app/src/main/res/values-th/strings.xml.
Build and confirm all unit tests pass.
acceptance_criteria: LibraryActivity.kt and AutoBridgeDesign.kt compile; `./gradlew testPersonalDebugUnitTest assemblePersonalDebug` succeeds.
Chip row has exactly 5 chips (TV, Radio, Music, Streaming, Files); no Favorites chip.
Category letter headers (A, B, ก, #) render in accent color, not muted grey.
ALL CATEGORIES header has a sort dropdown that toggles A-Z/Z-A reordering.
PINNED section has an 'Edit' link opening pin management.
Source card shows a folder glyph as badge and ▾ trailing chevron.
Header subtitle reads 'N channels · [source name]' when not searching.
A filled star header action toggles category pinning.
'↻ Check' button appears on the status summary row, not in the header.
Online dot is green (ACCENT_ONLINE), offline dot is red (DANGER) in the summary.
Tile status is a small colored dot on the artwork corner, not a text label.
New strings exist in both strings.xml files; no existing string renamed.
verification: Confirm new <string> entries added to both values/strings.xml and values-th/strings.xml
findings: All 11 fixes (9–19) implemented. Fix 9: FAVORITES removed from chips list (5 chips remain). Fix 10: letter headers override to ACCENT color. Fix 11: sort dropdown added to 'All categories' header, toggles A-Z/Z-A. Fix 12: 'Edit' link on PINNED section opens checkbox dialog. Fix 13: source card shows 📁 badge and ▾ trailing chevron. Fix 14: grid now 3 columns. Fix 15: subtitle reads 'N channels · sourceName'. Fix 16: star header action toggles pin. Fix 17: signal icon removed from header, ↻ Check pill added to checkSummaryRow. Fix 18: status dots use SpannableStringBuilder with green/red ForegroundColorSpan. Fix 19: contentTile shows 8dp colored dot on artwork corner instead of text label, setStatus() updates both dot and hidden label. signalIndicator field kept but resolves to null harmlessly. New EN/TH strings added: library_sort_az, library_sort_za, library_edit_pinned, library_check_button. New id autobridge_status_dot added. Build and testPersonalDebugUnitTest + assemblePersonalDebug pass.
